pointer_convention: RFC 6901 JSON pointers rooted at the case object; /payload is case.payload.
validation: Before first save, verified 48 unique case/sentence pairs, exact unchanged source quotes, allowed outcomes, and that every supplied source pointer resolves in its case payload. No answer key or peer output was used.
independence_limits: AI context with shared training, project commissioning, and procedural blinding on a shared nonsecure filesystem; see unchanged source-first metadata.json.
completion_policy: First-pass annotations saved once; no retries or silent postcompletion edits.
